# Split Stability of the Primary Baselines

*Auto-generated by `scripts/05_split_stability.py`.*

Cohort: 486 skeletons (385 toxic / 101 safe). The frozen scaffold split has 12 safe test compounds; this study measures how much results depend on that one split.

## B. Repeated 5-fold scaffold-grouped CV x 5 (pooled out-of-fold AUC-ROC over all 486 compounds)

## Reading (computed)

- **Split-to-split SD of test AUC-ROC:** structure 0.086, biology 0.077. A single-split difference smaller than about 0.17 (two SDs) should not be read as a real difference.
- **Pooled CV (repeat 0), structure:** AUC-ROC 0.638 [0.579, 0.697] — interval excludes 0.5: structure carries signal.
- **Pooled CV (repeat 0), biology:** AUC-ROC 0.504 [0.447, 0.568] — interval includes 0.5: no signal established.
- **Use for Phase 2:** a deep model must beat the pooled-CV baseline of its own modality by more than the split-to-split SD to count as an improvement.
- Intervals are bootstrap over compounds with fixed pooled predictions; they do not include training variability.
